freight_calculations.description: Numerical and procedural questions about freight pricing, fuel surcharges, dimensional weight, freight class, accessorial charges, and cost-per-mile.
freight_calculations.example_question: How is dimensional weight calculated for a less-than-truckload (LTL) shipment in the United States?
subtopics: cost-per-mile for refrigerated vs dry van

carrier_performance.description: Questions about measuring and managing carrier performance: on-time delivery, claims rate, tender acceptance, scorecards, and capacity allocation.
carrier_performance.example_question: What KPIs belong on a carrier scorecard, and how should each be weighted?
subtopics: capacity allocation across primary and backup carriers

claims_and_damages.description: Freight claim filing, valuation, and dispute processes; cargo insurance; Carmack Amendment liability.
claims_and_damages.example_question: What documents are required to file a concealed damage claim, and what is the typical filing deadline?
subtopics: freight claim valuation methods (invoice cost, replacement, depreciated)
released value vs full value protection
claim documentation (BOL, POD, photos, repair estimates)

routing_and_dispatch.description: Route planning, dispatch decisions, hours-of-service constraints, multi-stop optimization, and zone skipping.
routing_and_dispatch.example_question: How do hours-of-service rules constrain a driver's daily routing options?

sops_and_procedures.description: Warehouse and dock standard operating procedures: receiving, putaway, pick-pack-ship, loading, and cycle counts.
sops_and_procedures.example_question: What are the steps in a standard inbound receiving SOP for a palletized shipment?
subtopics: cycle count vs full physical inventory

regulations_and_compliance.description: FMCSA regulations, DOT compliance, customs and cross-border, hazmat, and security programs (C-TPAT, CSA).
regulations_and_compliance.example_question: What is the difference between C-TPAT and CSA, and which shippers benefit from each?
subtopics: DOT drug and alcohol testing program
